environment.description: Same Express application packaged as a Lambda function behind a Lambda Function URL. The Function URL is configured with AuthType: AWS_IAM. The Lambda function's resource-based policy contains no lambda:InvokeFunctionUrl permission grants for '*' principal — only the specific IAM role arn:aws:iam::111122223333:role/InternalServiceCallerRole has invoke permission. The Function URL response handling in the Lambda Web Adapter normalizes headers by stripping bytes 0x00-0x1F from header values before transmission. CloudWatch Logs show that unauthenticated requests (missing or invalid SigV4 signature) receive a 403 Forbidden response from the Lambda service itself before the function code executes.

config.response_handling: Lambda Web Adapter strips control characters (0x00-0x1F) from HTTP response header values
